shell_home_confirm_action: Destructive confirm button of the dialog that asks before running a project action from atlas.yaml that has a confirm message.
shell_home_missing_project_check_again: Button of the missing project screen: looks for the folder again (for example after a drive was reconnected).
shell_home_missing_project_last_known_pa: Tooltip of the path line on the missing project screen: where the folder used to be.
shell_home_missing_project_locate: Button of the missing project screen: opens a folder picker to point the project at its new folder. The ellipsis marks the picker.
shell_home_missing_project_relink: Button of the suggestion box: points the missing project at the suggested folder.
shell_home_missing_project_remove_all: Button of the missing project screen when several projects are missing: removes them all after a confirmation. {count} is how many; the screen shows it only for two or more, so the zero and one arms exist for the plural rule.
shell_home_missing_project_remove_from_a: Button of the missing project screen: removes the project from the list. Nothing on disk changes.
shell_home_missing_project_same_name: Reason Atlas gives for a suggested folder: it has the same name as the missing project.
shell_home_missing_project_same_remote: Reason Atlas gives for a suggested folder: it has the same git remote as the missing project.
shell_home_missing_project_searching: Status line while Atlas looks for a moved copy of the missing project.
shell_home_missing_project_suggestion: Heading of the suggestion box on the missing project screen. {name} is the project name.
shell_home_missing_project_suggestion_la: Accessible name of the box that suggests a moved copy of the missing project.
shell_home_missing_project_title: Title of the screen for a project whose folder is gone. {name} is the project name.
shell_home_missing_project_why: Explanation under the title of the missing project screen: the folder is gone from this computer, with the usual causes.
shell_home_no_project_add_project: Button of the empty states: opens a folder picker to add a project. The ellipsis marks the picker.
shell_home_no_project_discover: Button of the first-project empty state: scans the machine for projects to add.
shell_home_no_project_error_title: Title of the error shown when the list of projects cannot be read. The message with the path follows.
shell_home_no_project_first_hint: Text of the empty state for a new user with no project: what Atlas does with a folder.
shell_home_no_project_first_title: Title of the empty state for a new user with no project.
shell_home_no_project_none_title: Title of the empty state when projects exist but none is selected.
shell_home_no_project_pick_a_worktree: Text of the empty state when no project is selected. {key} is the shortcut of the jump palette, spelled by the platform.
shell_home_no_project_retry: Button of the project list error: reads the list again.
